title: Kakao 79%
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Ayano Tsubasa and Yuu Ichinose are inseparable childhood friends who are separated when both families move, then discover they have transferred to the same new school. A full-color webcomic comedy about their bittersweet teenage years as friendship slowly turns toward romance.
life_message: Long friendship and loyalty between two people can grow into something deeper if it is honest.
